name: Hana Bennett
original_name: ฮานะ เบนเนตต์
source:
Etymology: Hana = Flower | Bennett = Blessed
Age: 16
Nationality: Rosetanian
Role: Grade 10 Student / Class Star
Personality: Outwardly gentle and friendly, but secretly ambitious and calculating. Skilled at persuasion and image curation, she lives in fear of her secrets being exposed. She avoids direct confrontation, preferring complex schemes, and constantly battles an inner conflict between doing what is right and pursuing her own desires.

[From in-game profile]
